Read [Hardware Compatibility](../../docs/hardware.md) before testing or reporting. A driver listing or QEMU result does not show that FlashOS works on a physical device.

## FlashOS artifact

Give the release or candidate, filename, checksum, image type, and boot method.

## Device

Provide the manufacturer, exact model, architecture, firmware mode, and only the component details you intend to publish.

## Observations

Record boot, display, keyboard/input, storage, networking, audio, power, and shutdown results using the terms in the hardware guide. Mark untested items separately from unavailable or failed ones.

## Evidence

Attach concise logs or photos only after removing credentials, serial numbers, network identifiers, and unrelated personal information.

## Safety confirmation

State whether you wrote any physical media and how you identified the target model, size, and mounts first. Never give writing instructions that rely on an unresolved variable or a guessed device name.
